name: Default
shortDescription: Ticket shop for conferences, concerts and workshops, with PostgreSQL, Redis-backed background tasks and a periodic task runner.

alerts.message: Open /control/ and sign in as admin@localhost with the password admin. Do it right away and change the email address and password of this account.

Ticket and order emails need an SMTP server. Set PRETIX_MAIL_HOST, PRETIX_MAIL_PORT, PRETIX_MAIL_USER, PRETIX_MAIL_PASSWORD and PRETIX_MAIL_FROM (PRETIX_MAIL_TLS for STARTTLS or PRETIX_MAIL_SSL for SMTPS), then redeploy.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
